public_rationale: Contemporary studies document errors and weak self-correction, but those findings do not establish that superficial understanding causes the whole set of failures. Other experiments demonstrate limited factuality assessment, which challenges the strongest reading of constitutional inability. The evidence does not settle the combined causal claim without selecting meanings and thresholds Marcus did not supply.
limitations: Partial error detection is not reliable verification of arbitrary claims.
Task-specific experiments cannot establish a universal architectural limitation.
The causal conclusion depends on how understanding and fact-checking are defined.

our_interpretation: Assess the explanation of contemporary LLM behavior, not a forecast about all future architectures.
The ordinary reading is that limited reasoning and world knowledge cause the listed failures, rather than merely occurring alongside them.
Treat constitutional inability as a claim of an inherent limitation, while distinguishing imperfect fact-checking from inability to perform any factual verification.
Understanding needs an independent measure; defining it as whatever prevents errors would make the causal claim circular.
criteria.support_condition: Controlled evidence independently measures the claimed limitation and establishes that it causes the listed failures; evidence also supports an inherent barrier to fact-checking within the stated model scope.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Controlled evidence rejects the proposed causal explanation, or directly demonstrates the allegedly impossible capability under an unambiguous reading of fact-checking.

evidence.explanation: The experiments support limitations in intrinsic reasoning self-correction. They neither independently measure superficial understanding nor establish a universal inability to fact-check.

This is material counterevidence to reading fact-checking inability as an inability to detect any factual errors. The sampling-based method does not demonstrate infallible verification or settle the broader causal explanation.

Controlled inference experiments identify training-text memorization and word-frequency heuristics as contributors to errors. These findings are compatible with some readings of shallow understanding, but do not establish Marcus's explanation across all the listed behaviors.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: An independently specified measure of understanding and controlled interventions on contemporary models showing whether it causes the listed failures, together with a clear definition and test of the alleged fact-checking limitation.
